verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Aircall publishes an API reference listing endpoints (outbound calls, recording controls, transcription, campaigns) and step-by-step tutorials. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. A static endpoint listing is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
